title: GPD-enquete 1984 : Wij leven vrij ... en blij? Vrijheidsbeleving in Nederland.
authors: Praag, B.M.S. van, Hagenaars, A.J.M., Erasmus Universiteit Rotterdam * Rotterdam, Vall, M. van de, Rijksuniversiteit Leiden * Leiden (primary investigator)
contributors: Prof.Dr. B.M.S. van Praag, UVA, SEO (depositor)
Gemeenschappelijke Persdienst, GPD * Den Haag (research initiator)
Gemeenschappelijke Persdienst, GPD * Den Haag (data collector)
descriptions: The original survey was meant to measure the experience of freedom in every day life in the Netherlands 40 years after World War II. Because the only file still available only contains the variables containing 'hard' data, the original character of the study is lost. Background data, financial family data, social contacts, time budget, employment, evaluation of income. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ housing situation/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education/ politics/ consumption of durables/ organizational membership
